title: Add substring highlights to `PopupMenu` search
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Relates to #119116.
- Relates to #118571.

## Additional information

The editor's Quick Load dialog currently shows a highlight rectangle around each matched substring when doing fuzzy searching there, which makes it clear exactly why a particular item is matched against. However, `PopupMenu` does not do this, which can make the search results quite confusing at times, especially since `PopupMenu` currently preserves the ordering of the items and does not sort them based on their fuzzy search score, meaning the best result can technically be at the bottom.

These highlights should hopefully make it clearer why a particular item is being matched against at least.

The actual implementation takes a very similar approach as what `HighlightedLabel` does for `EditorQuickOpenDialog`, where it's a bespoke `Control` that just adds the highlight drawing on top of what's already there. So we've introduced a `HighlightedTextLine` that lives next to `PopupMenu`, similar to how `HighlightedLabel` lives next to `EditorQuickOpenDialog`.

We've also added theme constants for `PopupMenu`, using the same value as what's used by `EditorQuickOpenDialog` (or `HighlightedLabel` rather). I'll leave the final values to someone else to fine-tune.

@@ -732,6 +732,9 @@
 		<member name="search_bar_fuzzy_search_max_misses" type="int" setter="set_search_bar_fuzzy_search_max_misses" getter="get_search_bar_fuzzy_search_max_misses" default="2">
 			Sets the maximum number of mismatches allowed in each search result when fuzzy searching is enabled for the [PopupMenu] search bar. Any item with more mismatches will be hidden from the search results.
 		</member>
+		<member name="search_bar_highlights_enabled" type="bool" setter="set_search_bar_highlights_enabled" getter="is_search_bar_highlights_enabled" default="true">
+			If [code]true[/code], enables highlighting of all of the substrings that together match the search query.
+		</member>
 		<member name="search_bar_min_item_count" type="int" setter="set_search_bar_min_item_count" getter="get_search_bar_min_item_count" default="0">
 			Sets the minimum number of items required for the search bar to be visible. [member search_bar_enabled] must be [code]true[/code] for this to have any effect. Separator items are not counted.
 		</member>
@@ -799,6 +802,12 @@
 		<theme_item name="font_separator_outline_color" data_type="color" type="Color" default="Color(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 			The tint of text outline of the labeled separator.
 		</theme_item>
+		<theme_item name="search_highlight_border_color" data_type="color" type="Color" default="Color(0.5, 0.7, 1, 0.4)">
+			[Color] used for the outline of the search bar's match highlights. See [member search_bar_highlights_enabled].
+		</theme_item>
+		<theme_item name="search_highlight_color" data_type="color" type="Color" default="Color(1, 1, 1, 0.07)">
+			[Color] used for the fill of the search bar's match highlights. See [member search_bar_highlights_enabled].
+		</theme_item>
 		<theme_item name="gutter_compact" data_type="constant" type="int" default="1">
 			If not [code]0[/code], the icon gutter will be merged with the checkbox gutter when possible. This acts as a boolean.
 		</theme_item>
